title: 第十六章 上门找茬？刀疤男当场跪崩
novel_title: 救命！我的神煞师父怎么天天亲我
content_zh:
大灯亮起，货架上堆满了乌黑发亮的发丝，每一缕都缠绕着鬼气。

    她伸手轻轻抚摸，无数记忆涌入脑海。

    紧闭的房间里，关着无数年轻女孩或少妇，她们遍体鳞伤，衣不蔽体。

    恐惧，思念，绝望，痛苦的情绪铺天盖地地朝她袭来，缠得她心头发闷。

    半小时过去，姜无念才缓缓松开手，正想转身问董代梅细节，外间忽然传来了一声刺耳的玻璃爆裂声。

    姜无念快步冲到外间，天色已暗，理发店大门被砸得稀烂，玻璃渣碎了一地，场面一片狼藉。

    心里着急得不行，到处找那个熟悉的身影，完了完了，小灵丹呢？

    一群凶神恶煞的壮汉堵在门口，跟傅烬川遥遥对峙，空气里弥漫着一股看不见的火药味。

    见他没事，姜无念才放下心来，这些人要是敢碰了她的小灵丹，她可就不管什么因果了，直接搓成丸子喂野鬼！

    “老大，就是这小子揍得咱们！”刚才放狠话的小弟缩在刀疤男身后，指着傅烬川喊。

    屋里很暗，为首的刀疤男叼着雪茄，戴着副墨镜，气焰相当嚣张，看都没看便粗声喝道：“小子，是你伤了我的人？”

    他嗤笑一声，不屑地看着傅烬川，“胆子够肥啊！不想死就马上跪下认错，再留下你一双手。”

    话音一转，他的目光又黏在姜无念身上，眯起眼露出不怀好意的笑，“你旁边这小丫头留下，就当赔我兄弟们的医药费。”

    傅烬川周身瞬间覆上一层戾气，心底杀意顿起，找死。

    面前忽然伸出根纤细的手指，在他眼前晃了晃，姜无念唇角勾着笑，压低声音念叨：“一万块，为师帮你搞定，怎么样？”

    万一小灵丹被打坏了怎么办？她想着正好赚点零花钱，还能在小徒弟面前露一手，顺便让小灵丹不受伤，一举三得，划算！

    侧头看她，傅烬川面上掠过一丝诧异，人家就是冲她来的，她还上赶着去送死，怎么哪壶不开提哪壶。

    他突然有点同情姜无念。

    虽然她有点玄学在身上，但是脑子似乎不好使。

    他轻轻摇头：“一边去。”

    刀疤男想找个地方坐下，却因为看不见而不耐烦地吼身边的小弟。

    “大晚上黑灯瞎火的，怎么不开灯！”

    小弟有些犹豫，指了指他的脸，“老大……那个……”
content_en:
The headlights turned on, and the shelves were filled with shiny black hair, each strand entwined with ghostly aura.

    She reached out and touched it gently, and countless memories flooded into her mind.

    In the closed room, there are countless young girls or young women, their bodies are covered with bruises and their clothes are not covered.

    Fear, longing, despair, and painful emotions attacked her overwhelmingly, making her feel depressed.

    Half an hour passed before Jiang Wunian slowly let go of his hand. Just as he was about to turn around and ask Dong Daimei for details, there was suddenly a harsh sound of glass bursting outside.

    Jiang Wu Nian hurriedly rushed outside. It was already dark. The door of the barber shop was smashed to pieces, glass shards were shattered on the ground, and the scene was a mess.

    I was so anxious that I looked everywhere for that familiar figure. It's over, where's the little elixir?

    A group of fierce and strong men blocked the door, confronting Fu Jinchuan from afar. The air was filled with an invisible smell of gunpowder.

    Seeing that he was fine, Jiang Wunian felt relieved. If these people dared to touch her little elixir, she would not care about the cause and effect, and would just make it into balls and feed them to the wild ghosts!

    "Boss, this guy is the one who beat us up!" The younger brother who had spoken harshly just huddled behind the scarred man, pointing at Fu Jinchuan and shouting.

    The room was very dark. The scarred man in the lead was holding a cigar and wearing sunglasses. He was quite arrogant and shouted harshly without even looking: "Boy, are you the one who hurt me?"

    He sneered and looked at Fu Jinchuan with disdain, "You are so brave! If you don't want to die, kneel down and admit your mistake immediately, and I will keep your hands."

    As soon as the words changed, his eyes were fixed on Jiang Wunian again, and he narrowed his eyes and smiled maliciously, "If you keep the little girl next to you, you will be responsible for paying my brothers' medical expenses."

    Fu Jinchuan's whole body was instantly covered with a layer of hostility, and murderous intent arose in his heart, seeking death.

    Suddenly a slender finger stretched out in front of him and waved it in front of his eyes. Jiang Wunian smiled at the corners of his lips and muttered in a low voice: "Ten thousand yuan, I can help you get it done for you, how about it?"

    What if the elixir is damaged? She thought that she could earn some pocket money, show off her skills in front of her little apprentice, and at the same time keep the little elixir from getting hurt. It was a great deal to kill three birds with one stone!

    Looking sideways at her, a trace of surprise flashed across Fu Jinchuan's face. They were just here for her, and she was rushing to die. Why didn't she open any pot?

    He suddenly sympathized with Jiang Wu Nian.

    Although she has some metaphysics in her body, her brain seems to be not working well.

    He shook his head slightly: "Let's go."

    The scarred man wanted to find a place to sit down, but because he couldn't see, he yelled at the boy next to him impatiently.

    "It's so dark at night, why don't you turn on the lights?"

    The younger brother hesitated and pointed at his face, "Boss...that..."
title_en: Chapter 16: Coming to find trouble? The scarred man collapsed on his knees on the spot
